measurement: First render plus synchronous RGBA copy; serial fresh processes; driver/system caches retained; no tracing in timed medians.
scope: Full vertex uploads above 32 MiB transfer a vector allocation to BGFX makeRef with an independent release callback. Small uploads and material patches retain copying.
pilot_rounds: Partial PowerShell 5 round interrupted by diagnostic stderr handling; complete initial implementation round also preserved. Final round uses the rebuilt version that releases remaining CPU indices and includes pending-upload device-loss tests.
